notes: Export at any size your plan includes - 720p, 1080p or 4K - whatever the size of your video. Before, a 720p phone video could only be exported at 720p, even on Pro. A size above your video's own is marked "upscaled": it fills a bigger screen, but can't add detail the video doesn't have.
The export starts at the size closest to your video's own, so nothing gets bigger unless you choose it.

The separate Clip sound row is gone from the timeline: each clip's sound now shows inside the clip on the Video row, so deleting sound there can no longer delete the video with it. Mute every clip's sound with the 🔊 button on the Video row.
Captions no longer skip parts of a voice recording that was cut into pieces on the Audio row: short pieces were sometimes taken for noise and left out.
Fewer missed words in captions: speech that was skipped at the start or in the middle of a sentence is now listened to again.
More accurate Sinhala, Tamil, Hindi, Kannada and Telugu captions on computers with a supported graphics card: names and places come out right more often, at the same speed.

More English words stay in English in Sinhala captions, also with an ending joined on: "video එකක්", "phone එකේ", "New Zealand වල". Words like web, center, concept, digital, marketing, brand and social media are now recognised too.
Fixed captions sometimes showing a broken character at the end of a word.

Split screen: put several videos on screen at once - side by side, stacked, a 2 x 2 grid, one large with smaller ones, or a small one over the main video. Canvas > Split screen has 13 layouts and a custom grid, with spacing between screens. Every screen stays its own layer you can move, resize, crop or animate.
Video layers can be cropped (drag the bars on their edges, or type the amounts), stretched to any shape, and given rounded corners, a border and a drop shadow.
Resize a layer from any corner, place it in a corner or the middle with one click, and type its exact position, width, height and rotation.
Dragging a layer snaps to the edges and centre of the picture and to other layers, with guide lines. Hold Alt to drag freely.
Align, distribute and match the size of several layers at once, or fit one to the picture. Ctrl+click layers on the preview to select several and drag them together; Ctrl+arrows move them a little.

The Layers list shows every layer with its thumbnail and type. Rename a layer, duplicate it, drag it to change which is on top, hide it or lock it. A duplicate lands exactly on its original and can be changed without touching it.
The Videos row on the timeline shows which video layer is on top: higher on the row is higher in the picture.
Exports with several video layers are faster: about twice as fast with four layers.
Translate voice to English leaves far fewer words out of long sentences (about 1 in 100, down from about 1 in 9 in our tests): the English is now spoken in shorter parts.
Translated speech no longer gets cut off at the end of the video: the last sentences are sped up a little and moved into the silence before them.
Translated sentences now play at an even volume: none comes out much quieter or louder than the ones around it, and nothing clips.
After translating, a short note tells you which sentences to check, if any came out empty, looked wrong or didn't fit.
Translation is faster on most videos and leaves more of your computer free for editing while it runs. Removing the voice from the background is faster too.
Clearer messages when translation can't run: not enough disk space, not enough memory, a damaged download, or which step failed.
The free plan now exports up to 1080p in the desktop app.
Voice translation is free to try on any length: the free plan exports up to 1 minute of translated voice, Lite up to 10 minutes, Starter up to 30 minutes and Pro any length.
Blurring your webcam background is free. Removing or replacing it is included from Lite.
The free plan includes one full Clean up audio per video and a Draft for recordings up to 5 minutes. Enhance voice stays free.

Plans changed: green screen, blend modes, speed curves, masks, LUTs, curves, stabilization, and GIF, audio-only, high-quality and 60 fps exports are now in Starter, and custom fonts in Pro. Lite passes bought before this update keep all of these until they end.

Translate voice to English now works entirely on your computer: the transcript is translated on this machine too, so nothing is uploaded. The first time, it downloads the translation model once along with the voice models (about 5 GB in all).

Text, captions, music, voice and effects now move with the clip under them when you trim, move, split, speed up or delete clips, so nothing drifts out of sync. Lock a layer to keep it in place, or turn this off with the ⛓ button on the Video row.

Select several items at once: Shift or Ctrl+click, drag a box on an empty part of the timeline, or press Ctrl+A. Move, nudge (Alt+arrows), delete, copy and paste them together. Ctrl+G groups them so one click selects them all; Ctrl+Shift+G ungroups.
Quick trims: Q deletes everything before the playhead and W everything after it, in the selected layer or the clip under the playhead. Shift+Delete deletes and closes the gap it leaves.
Keyframes now show as diamonds on the timeline. Drag one to retime it, click it to jump there, Alt+click to remove it.

Each clip's own sound has its own Clip sound row: fade it in and out, draw a volume curve on it, mute it, or press Detach audio to move it to its own track. Video layers have their own Video 2 row, with Fill the frame and Fit in the frame.
Markers: press M to drop one, drag it to move it, double-click to rename it. Up and Down jump between cuts and markers.
Set a range with I and O, then cut it, loop it or export just that part.
Alt+drag a clip to slip it (another part of its video in the same place) and Alt+drag a cut to roll it between two clips. J, K and L control playback, and a slider zooms the timeline.
Any speed from 0.1x slow motion to 10x time-lapse.
Fade a clip's look or an effect in and out, or set how strongly it shows at any moment.
Duplicate a clip with Ctrl+D or the Duplicate button in the clip panel.
Captions keep English words in English when you speak Sinhala, Tamil, Hindi or other Indian languages, instead of spelling them out in that script. Switch it off in the Captions panel.
Click the combined captions block on the timeline to style every caption at once: preset, font, size, color, outline, background and position.
The caption Style tab now starts from how your captions look, so changing one setting, like the size, keeps their font, letter case and animation.
Edit text has a new Full text view: all your captions as one list you can read top to bottom and fix in place. Click a time to jump to it. Detailed still shows each caption's timing.
Smooth cuts: every audio part now fades in and out over a few milliseconds, so cuts in a voice or music track don't click. It's on by default; switch it off with the ∿ button on the Audio row.
Magnetic audio: turn on the ⊓ button on the Audio row and the parts you cut from one recording stay back to back, like the clips on the video row. Delete or trim a part and the rest slide along.
Fixed exports failing when a very short clip had a speed curve.
Fixed exports failing when an audio track used a voice tone preset.
Saved project files now keep your cleaned-up audio, so a reopened project sounds the same.
Fixed Clean up audio failing on files with certain characters in their name, such as curly quotes.

New Clean up audio: pick what to fix - noise, echo, background audio, clipping, mouth sounds, wind, breaths, long silences, hesitations and filler words - and press Enhance to do it all at once. Find it in the Audio panel and in Review.
Remove background audio keeps only your voice, taking out music, TV and other sounds behind it. It downloads its model once and runs on your computer.
Remove echo makes a voice recorded in an empty or echoey room sound closer. Choose Light, Medium or Strong.
Breaths between sentences are turned down, and mouth clicks and lip smacks are removed.
Hesitation sounds like "aaa" and "mmm" are now found even when the transcript writes them as a short word, which helps Sinhala, Tamil and Hindi speech most.
Enhance voice in one click: on an audio track, clearer and fuller speech, background noise reduced, distortion repaired and the level made even, ready for video.
Voice tone presets - Podcast, Warm, Fix thin mic and Reduce boom - or set bass, boxiness, clarity, leveling and softer "s" sounds yourself. What you hear in the preview is what you export.
Remove hesitation sounds like "aaa", "eee", "uhhh" and "mmm" in any language, found from the sound itself. Review > Remove fillers cuts them all in one step.
Draw a volume curve on any audio track: double-click the track in the timeline to add a point, drag it up or down.
Repair distortion: recordings that were too loud get their flattened peaks rebuilt (Audio > Clean up).
Check your microphone before recording: a five-second test tells you if you're too quiet, too loud or in a noisy room, and plays it back.
Fixed the Telephone and Radio voice effects sounding slightly different in the preview than in the export.
Remove, blur or replace your webcam background - no green screen needed. Pick it under Background on a webcam layer, or before you record to see it live. It runs on your computer.

Draft can now read your screen on your computer: chapters named after what was on screen, cuts for waiting, labels for the buttons you clicked, and a privacy check for emails, keys and card numbers that you review before export.
New Scenes tab shows the parts of your recording at a glance - click one to jump there.
A Projects button in the editor takes you back to your projects (your work is saved).
Fixed: the preview could get stuck on one frame after the playhead reached the end of the video.
Smoother recording on modest computers: capture no longer waits on a slow encoder, lighter previews, and sensible defaults (720p, lighter webcam) on lower-end PCs.
Fixed: the More menu in the editor opened behind the video preview.
Smarter automatic zoom: clicks a few seconds apart stay in one zoom, and the camera pans between areas instead of zooming out and back in.
Typing gets one steady zoom that frames the whole line, even for long texts and when you press shortcuts while typing.
Choose the recording type - Tutorial, Demo or Gaming - for zooms that suit it.
Smoother, more natural zoom motion for new zooms.
The drawn cursor and click highlights now grow with the zoom, in the preview and the exported video. You can also match the cursor to its size on your screen.
Fixed the cursor running slightly ahead of the picture while the camera moved in the preview.
Twelve new transitions between clips, including soft sweeps, radial, diagonal and shape transitions.
Edit captions by hand: fix the text and timing of every caption in one list, join or delete captions, and find and replace a word in all of them at once.
Style captions your way: font, weight, capitals, italic, text and outline colors, outline thickness, shadow, a background box, size and alignment, with a live preview.
More accurate captions: list names and special words before generating so they are spelled right, and turn on Best accuracy for fewer wrong words.
Longer captions now break at natural pauses.
Fixed exports with captions or long text failing with "An image has an unsupported size".
Long recordings with many cuts can now be exported (up to 1000 clips).
Fixed exports with many captions failing with "Too many layers": long captioned videos now export.
Fixed exports with captions or stickers coming out in the wrong colours in some players.
Fixed every export failing with "Export failed" since the app started using a newer video engine.
Fixed exports failing after translating the voice of a video longer than about five minutes.
When an export fails, it now says why.
Open, edit and export videos of any length. Exports are no longer stopped after 20 minutes, and a finished export is saved straight from disk, so long videos no longer run out of memory.
Captions, voice translation, loudness and timeline waveforms now work on long videos and large files, and start faster.
Exporting the same videos again is quicker: they are checked once, not on every export.
The free plan exports videos up to 10 minutes; paid plans export any length.
A simpler editor: tools and the settings for what you select now open in one panel beside the menu, so the video preview gets more room.
Clip settings are split into Basics, Speed & sound and Frame tabs instead of one long list.
Filters show a clearer preview of each look, and Canvas sizes show their shape.
Transitions open in their own tab like Filters and Adjust, and the tab bars no longer need scrolling.
The account menu keeps working when you're offline.

New: Translate voice to English. In the Transcript panel, Sinhala, Tamil, Hindi, Kannada or Telugu speech is said again in English in the speaker's own voice, over the video's own music and sounds. It lands as new audio tracks you can undo.
English captions are far more accurate: quiet speech and the ends of long sentences were being missed.
New speech models for Kannada, Tamil, Telugu and Hindi, with several times fewer mistakes. Kannada and Telugu are now in the language list.
Detect automatically now tells Sinhala, Kannada, Tamil, Telugu and Hindi apart, and asks you to pick the language when it can't tell.
Captions are faster on computers without a supported graphics card.
Fixed captions sometimes repeating the same phrase over and over.
Speech model downloads now carry on where they stopped if the connection drops.
Fixed captions saying there's no sound in videos opened from your computer, and missing audio waveforms on the timeline.
Captions are much faster in the desktop app: speech is now recognised on your computer by WipeClip's engine.
New Sinhala speech model for clearer, more accurate Sinhala captions.
Captions in seconds on supported graphics cards: turn it on in the Captions panel.
Auto language detection now recognises Sinhala and asks before downloading its model.
Fixed Sinhala captions sometimes filling up with the same repeated characters.
Fixed captions showing as broken images in long videos.
Faster speech recognition for captions.
Short captions no longer pile up on top of each other in the timeline.
Fixed captions getting stuck on laptops with two graphics cards: the faster one is now used.
Fixed the processing engine failing to start after updating from an older version.
Fixed the processing engine failing to start on some computers.
